items.title_orig: The Big Change: Channel Guide Changes 9-1-26
items.article_text:
Some music fans are going to be very upset. Octane and Lithium have been booted off satellite The channel guide appears to be wrong.
 DISCLAIMER: I don't work for SXM, I just grab the channel guide each day and compare them. This was a personal project that I started to post here because SXM can't usually be bothered.
 You may want to refresh your radio to ensure all channels are in the right places.
 Channels higher than 234 are generally limited to the app and 360L radios. Classic Rewind, Octane, Lithium, and the miscellaneous Sports PBP channels have moved into that area.
